text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
ALLLL RIGHT!!
I'm heading out!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いよっしゃあぁぁぁーーーっ！
行ってくるぜーーーっっ！！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Sir Knight!
Sure is another beautiful day for an adventure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よう、
騎士公っ！
まったく今日もいい冒険日和だなー！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, about that...
There was "Obtain Raw Demon Barley, Raw Demon Rice, and Raw Demon Eggs", and "Hunt Down the Red Capybara, Blue Capybara, and Yellow Capybara".
But none of those quests really set off the old Golshi-chan radar, ya feel me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがよー、
「生魔麦生魔米生魔卵の入手」だの、
「赤カピバラ青カピバラ黄カピバラの討伐」だの。
ゴルシちゃんレーダーにビビッと来る依頼はなくてさー

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I figured, if nobody's posting any interesting quests, why not post one myself?
So I put up a quest and accepted it myself... WAIT A SECOND?!
Did I just invent a perpetual motion machine?! Gotta go file a patent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
依頼が無ければ、
自分で依頼すればいいじゃない。
ってことで、
自分が出した依頼を自分で受けてみた……
ハッ！？
これ永久機関発見しちゃったんじゃね？　
ちょっと特許出願してくるわ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously...
"Defeat the Last Boss"!
There's no other choice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃもちろん
「ラスボス討伐」一択だろ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Well, you see, I felt as though fate itself had led me here.
I'd had a fried egg for breakfast that morning, and, as usual, I drizzled some soy sauce over it...
And then, would you believe it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは……
いえね、
何か運命のようなものに導かれたんですよ。
実は、
朝食に目玉焼きが出ましてね。
で、
いつものように醤油を垂らしたんです……
そしたら驚きましたよ。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The soy sauce had formed the shape of a Hero's crest!
So I decided to accept my destiny... the destiny of being a Hero!
...Or so I'd like to say! Ahaha! Gosh, that's embarrassing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その醤油の形がね、
勇者の紋章に見えたんです。
それで
運命を受け入れることに……
アタシは
勇者なんだって運命を。
なーんて！　
なんだか照れくさいや、
ははっ。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm gonna go beat the Last Boss!
See you later!
Adios Amigo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っつー訳でちょっとラスボス倒してくるわっ！
んじゃな、
アディオスアミーゴ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're saying it's just too much for a lovely, graceful princess like me?
...That's not it?
Then what ARE you saying?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
貴方みたいな可憐で麗しいお姫さまにはとても無理だって？
言ってない？　
んじゃーどういう事だよ？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAAAAAAAA?!
text_block_list.orig_text: はああぁぁああ～～～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously?
The Last Boss has already been defeated?! And not even that long ago?! Let's see...
Was it "Department Head Vinegared Kelp" or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……マジかよ、
もうラスボス倒されちまったの？
しかもちょい前に？　
えーと……
『部長酢昆布です』だっけ。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, talk about bad luck.
Did I end up being born in the wrong era...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちっ、
ついてねえ。
生まれる時代を間違えたか……？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what should I do?
...Say, in this game, you can't go back to the past or anything, right?
Are there no spells or items that let you do that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー
どうしよ。
……なー
このゲームってさ、
過去とかいけねーんだっけ？
なんか
それっぽい魔法とかアイテムとかねーの？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What a half-baked answer!
Keep that up, and you'll end up with nothing but half-cooked oden! Is that really what you want...?
I thought we were aiming to become the Oden Kings?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
煮え切らねー態度だな。
そんなんじゃ生煮えのおでんしかできねーぜ？
それでいいのかよ……
俺たち、
おでん王目指してたんじゃなかったのか！？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ding-a-ling!
text_block_list.orig_text: ピロリーンッ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, I've just had an idea.
A foolproof way to travel to the past.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フッ、
思いついちまったぜ。
過去に行く
とっておきの方法を。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And so! Do you know someone who can use thunder magic?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って訳で！
雷の魔法使えるやつ知らね？

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text:
Thunder magic, you say...?
Is that why you came to me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
雷の魔法……
ですか？
それでわたしのところへ？

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text:
I cannot seem to grasp the flow of this conversation...
What could traveling to the past possibly have to do with thunder magic...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
話の流れが、
よくわからないのですが。
過去に行くことと、
雷の魔法に
一体どんな関係が……？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
You don't know?
It's all about the "time slip".
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
知らねーの？
タイムスリップの方法。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: A time... slip?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……タイム、
スリップ？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible speed" and "a thunder strike".
Put those two together, and you can travel through space and time!
I'm pretty sure I saw it in some old movie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『ものすごいスピード』と
『落雷』。
この二つが揃えば
人は時空を超えられるんだ。
なんか昔の映画で見た気がするぜ！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text:
...Hah.
In other words, you want me to strike you with a thunder while you run at full speed...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ。
つまり
全速力で走るあなたに向かって、
雷を落とせばいいと……

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Exactly so♪
Alright, let's go!
On your marks~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうこと♪
んじゃあ、
いくぜ！
位置について～……

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: DOOORYAAAAAAAAHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: どおおりゃぁぁあああーっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text:
What impressive speed...!
On par with Croce in her Aerial configuration, perhaps.
No, she might even be faster~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ものすごいスピードですね……
空戦仕様のクローチェと同じくらい、
でしょうか。
いえ、
それよりも速いかも──

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!
What's with all the chit-chat, Lady Lyrael?!
Bring on the thunder!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい、
何おしゃべりしてんだよライラエルさまーっ！
電撃魔法バッチコーイ！！

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text:
...Are you quite sure about this?
I will try my best to hold back a little, but I will not be held responsible for whatever happens to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当によろしいんですね。
一応手加減は致しますが、
どうなっても知りませんよ。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text:
Then receive it with your own body...
The thunder of Divine Will.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならば、
その身で受けるがいい。
天意の雷を。

text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Hundred Thunder Night Sky... Low Voltage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
百雷夜天──
弱火。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: HONGYAIAIAAAAAAAAA!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんぎゃぁ゛ぁ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛～
～～っっ！！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aiaiaiai......

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──フッ。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Where am I?
...Who am I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ココハドコ？
……アタシハダレ？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...My name is Golorine.
The Vegetable Princess of the Kingdom of Goldosol... Ain't that crazy☆
...Alright, my head's still working fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アタシは
ゴルリーヌ。
ゴルドソル王国のお野菜プリンセス、
やべえですぞ☆
……よし、
頭は正常だ。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, though, Lady Lyrael is one scary lady.
Who actually goes and casts a real spell?!
Sure, I asked her to do it, but obviously I was just joking around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っつーかとんでもねえやつだったぜライラエルさま。
普通マジで魔法撃ってくるか？
確かに
頼んだのは
アタシだけど、
かわいい冗談に決まってんじゃん。

text_block_list.text: ...How very noisy.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……騒がしいですね。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm...? Who are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？
アンタ誰？

text_block_list.name: Vision Empress
text_block_list.text:
I should be asking you that.
No one should be able to enter this domain without my permission.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはこちらのセリフです。
この領域に私の許可なく、
他人が足を踏み入れられるはずがないのですが。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what's that supposed to mean?
It's like you're saying I'm some kind of "chosen one"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヤダ、
何それ。
まるでアタシが選ばれし者みたいな言い方じゃ──

text_block_list.name: Vision Empress
text_block_list.text: What is it?
text_block_list.orig_text: なにか？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My Golshi-chan sensors are going absolutely bonkers.
...Looks like I've hit bingo.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴルシちゃんセンサーが
ビンビンに反応してやがる。
……どうやら
ビンゴってわけだ。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So you're the Last Boss!
The "Pretty Girl Dempsey Roll", right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタがラスボス！
『美少女デンプシーロール』
だな！？

text_block_list.name: Vision Empress
text_block_list.text:
That name is completely off mark.
I will eliminate you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
全然違います。
排除しますね。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: BUBYAOOOOOHHHHHHHH!!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ぶびゃぉ゛ぉ゛お゛お゛お゛～～っっ！！？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Where am I?
Who am I?
...I am Golkokkoro. Your humble servant, you lousy Lord.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ココハドコ？　
アタシハダレ？
……アタシは
ゴルッコロ。
キサマの従者でございます、
主の野郎。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Listen to this, {0}!
I actually managed to travel back in time!
I even got to meet the last boss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっなっ聞いてくれよ、{0}！
マジでタイムスリップできたぞ！　
ラスボスにも会えたぜ！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...
That said she was one hell of a lady, that "Pretty Girl Dempsey Roll" bastard...
Huh? Wait. Was it "Meteorological Agency Entrance"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっそー……
でもめちゃくちゃ強かったな、
『美少女デンプシーロール』の野郎……
あれ？
『気象庁エントランス』だっけ？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hah! I can't just leave it at a loss...
Time for some special training!
Get the shogi board out here!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ、
負けたままじゃいられねえ、
特
訓だぁ！
将棋盤を用意しろぉいっ！！

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Shogi puzzles.
text_block_list.orig_text: 詰将棋。

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right!
I'll defeat the last boss and protect this world!
I swear it, on my name as an Umamusume!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゃあっ！
　
アタシがラスボスを倒し、
この世界を守ってみせる！
ウマ娘の名に懸けてッ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's fighting spirit burns bright!
But can she defeat the Last Boss, Vision Empress, when she has already been defeated?
And, more importantly, why go to all that trouble...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
闘志を燃やすゴールドシップ。
果たして彼女は、
すでに倒されたラスボス『幻境竜后』を倒すことができるのか。
そして、
わざわざそれをする意味とは──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: This is the tale of a girl who will become a "legend"...
text_block_list.orig_text: これは一人の少女が“伝説”になる物語──
